enchantments.tooltip: Spellcasting Implement +33: Passive: +33 Implement bonus to Universal Spell Power.
+15 Enhancement Bonus: +15 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Proficiency: Longsword: While equipped this item grants the wielder all required knowledge to wield a Longsword without proficiency penalties.
Insightful Devotion +78: Passive: +78 Insightful bonus to Positive (Healing) Spell Power.
Insightful Spell Lore V: Passive: All of your spells gain a 5% Insightful bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Profane Spell Focus Mastery +2: +2 Profane bonus to the DC of all spells.
Quality Spell Penetration +3: Passive: +3 Quality bonus to Spell Penetration checks.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
